top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, original and mature discovery chain: Holst on human GLP-1 secretion and glucose-dependent insulinotropic action, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology and receptor actions, and Mojsov on identification and synthesis of the active truncated peptide. The mechanism is replicated over decades and the clinical consequence is confirmed in large independent randomised trials for glycaemia, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcomes. The discovery-domain citation avoids drug-development credit disputes. No award is clearly inferior to a prize of this standard.
